{{Top|leg}}
The '''Vacationer's district''' was a district on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] with many skyrises, occupied mainly by spas, restaurants, hostels, and other businesses serving mainly tourists and celebrants from other places in the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]].

[[Kallad's Dream Vacation Hostel]] was located here.
